title: Azure Hawk Halberd Canon
summary: An elite canon that teaches the halberd as a hawk's stoop and climb with a finishing cleave that takes the sky.

title: Paired Courts of the Long Axe
summary: An elite text that sets two courts of attack and answer against each other inside one long axe's reach.

title: Basin-Spanning Halberd Treatise
summary: A treatise on spanning the whole basin of a fight with the halberd from rim to floor and back.

title: Twin Current Halberd Discourse
summary: A discourse on fighting with two currents of qi at once as a river runs in two channels.

title: Stoop and Climb Halberd Canon
summary: An elite canon of the halberd that climbs to a high line and stoops on the guard in paired motions.

title: Halberd of the Two-Court Sky
summary: An elite text that sets two courts against one another under the open azure sky and opens both with one stroke.

title: Flood Season Halberd Treatise
summary: An elite treatise that teaches the halberd by the rising of a river through flood season to the crest.

title: Hawk Over River Halberd Canon
summary: An elite canon that joins the hawk's high watch to the river's course in one long halberd style.

title: Halberd of the Open Plateau
summary: An elite text for fighting on the open plateau where wind and reach decide every exchange.

title: Sworn Bearings of the Gale Axe
summary: An elite text of sworn bearings that lets the halberd hold a line against a gale and strike along it.

title: Open Field Halberd Oath
summary: An oath-bound text that trusts the open field and the wind over any fixed guard and defends by motion.

title: Oath-Wind Halberd Discourse
summary: A discourse on binding a sworn oath to the wind itself so the halberd cleaves where the gale already blows.

title: Halberd of the Taken Bearing
summary: An elite text on taking a bearing from the gale and cutting only along the line that bearing draws.

title: Crosswind Halberd Discourse
summary: A discourse on using a gale that blows across the line of attack to turn blades and carry strokes.

title: The Long Plateau Halberd Canon
summary: An elite canon for a halberd carried across the whole plateau with the wind and fought without rest.

title: Halberd Under the Wide Sky
summary: An elite text of the wide sky that teaches the sworn halberd to fight where nothing stands overhead or aside.
